snippet.title: PlayStation - Strike Point (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
FLY THE FASTEST CHOPPERS IN THE SKY!

Hex, a twisted terrorist organization, has positioned deadly Shockwave devices worldwide. If triggered, these weapons will cause earthquakes, floods, volcanic eruptions - in short, total destruction of the ecosystem. As leader of the newly formed StrikePoint team, your mission is to take on Hex, destroying their strongholds and defusing their tectonic threats.
